title: Construction Project Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager. Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee construction projects from conception to completion.
- Develop project schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
- Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients.
- Ensure projects comply with building codes and safety regulations.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field.
- Proven track record of successfully managing commercial construction projects.
- Strong leadership and negotiation skills.
- Excellent knowledge of construction materials, processes, and equipment.
